about: What a Rust-shaped release archive (build/rust_release.py) may weigh, packed as the archive packs it (each staged file deflated at level 9, in MiB), by tests/data/release_budget.json's margin rule: the next 0.1 MiB above the measure plus one more language catalog (standard about 0.03, advanced about 0.05). The app keys count what rust_release.collect_app stages (the plugin tree, the data the core reads, the D9 stubs; no binary, no window); the binaries keys count payload/app/bin and car-legacy's payload/runtime. Measured on the packaging skeleton (S8.1, 2026-11-25, stub core): standard app 1.497 (rule: 1.6), advanced adds 1.183 (rule: 1.3); standard binaries 0.437 with car-legacy 0.262 of it (rule: 0.5), the advanced binaries weigh less than the standard ones (0.1 kept). S8.2 (2026-11-25): the setup program runs install.ps1 and keeps its log, and the stub core forwards to the installer proofs' double, through car-platform: standard binaries 0.603 with car-legacy 0.299 of it (rule: 0.7), the advanced binaries still lighter (0.1 kept). Integration 9 (2026-11-27): the P6 step 0 host contracts in car_core.dll and follow-3.14's JSON reader and writer (the per-kind nesting depth, the deep-stack thread in main_with and setup_main) bring the standard binaries to 0.709 with car-legacy 0.299 of it (rule: 0.8; car-v0627-cifix alone weighed 0.697), the advanced binaries still lighter (0.1 kept). The binaries keys are the stub core's: PLAN 6.6 has P6 set them again from its first full build.
